_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Your symbol is '{symbol}'.
You take turns placing your symbol on a 5x5 board to form a line of four.
Lines can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.
Submit your move using the format '[4]' to mark cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Недопустимый формат хода. Используйте '[cell]', где ячейка 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Недопустимый номер ячейки: {cell}. Должно быть между 0 и {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Игрок {player_id} размещает свой символ ({symbol}) в поле ({row}, {col}).
